lens: Code quality — readability, maintainability, error handling, test coverage, deletion-safety
answer: PR #13 is a clean, well-scoped retirement of the one-time archive-orphan fitness lane. Merge commit 5953467 removes the kernel crate, app tool, three registry YAMLs, the pre-grit archive payload, and the workspace members. Cargo.lock is updated coherently (both archive-orphan packages dropped). ADR-0118 is added with proper supersedes/related front-matter (supersedes ADR-0052; related ADR-0116/0110-0113). ADR-0104 and ADR-0107 are amended in-place to point to ADR-0118 rather than silently rewriting history. docs/CHANGELOG.md adds a 2026-05-16 retirement entry. docs/fitness-lanes/INDEX.md no longer lists archive-orphan as an executable lane — its row is rewritten to status=retired with runtime_budget=0 and a 'no CI invocation' marker, and a retirement row is appended to the change-log table. The kept .omc and docs lane files are converted to retirement stubs that preserve IP-008 traceability without code. CI on the merge commit is fully green (14 checks SUCCESS, 1 SKIPPED). The dispatcher tool edit (tools/oya-foundry-pr-review-dispatcher-app/Cargo.toml) is a 2-line comment-only update removing the stale 'archive-orphan' sibling-pattern example — related and minimal, not a stowaway. No compile-broken callers (no remaining `use oya_foundry_fitness_archive_orphan_kernel` in the tree at merge). Deletion-safety is strong: pure-function kernel, runner was a leaf binary, no other crate depended on the kernel. Quality concerns are minor and documentation-only.
key_claims: Merge commit 5953467 deletes all archive-orphan crates, payload, and registry YAMLs cleanly with no dangling references in tree at that revision.
Cargo.lock and Cargo.toml workspace members are mutually consistent post-merge (both archive-orphan packages removed from each).
ADR-0118 is shape-valid with explicit supersedes:[ADR-0052], related:[ADR-0116,0110-0113], a Rejected Alternatives section, and a Verification Plan — meets internal ADR contract.
ADR-0104 and ADR-0107 amendments are coherent: both retain the historical context and add a forward pointer to ADR-0118 instead of silently rewriting prior text.
docs/CHANGELOG.md and docs/fitness-lanes/INDEX.md both record the retirement; INDEX.md row is rewritten rather than physically removed (preserves audit trail).
tools/oya-foundry-pr-review-dispatcher-app change is a 2-line comment cleanup (-archive-orphan from sibling list, +archive-orphan retired by ADR-0118); related to the retirement, not a stowaway.
Merge-commit CI rollup: 14 SUCCESS + 1 SKIPPED across cargo-fmt/clippy/check/nextest and fitness lanes — workspace builds and tests pass without the deleted crate.
uncertainty_areas: Local working tree has the deleted crates still present (git status shows neither M nor D for them on dev tip after fetch is unknown from this session) — almost certainly local state divergence, not a PR defect, since the merge commit tree confirms deletion.

registry/glossary-vocabulary/warning-sources.tsv still lists docs/fitness-lanes/archive-orphan.md as the source of two uncited-acronym warnings (ARCHIVE, MASTERPLAN) — file is retained as a retirement stub so the entries remain technically valid, but the warning rows could be regenerated to point at ADR-0118 instead.
The dispatcher comment edit shipped under this PR rather than a dedicated 'documentation-sync' PR — defensible (it's the natural moment to drop the stale sibling reference) but mixes scopes slightly.
anti_patterns_detected: None blocking. Minor: the retired-lane row in INDEX.md uses the literal string 'retired' in 5 columns — readable but a sentinel value rather than a status enum; acceptable for a doc table.

findings.summary: registry/glossary-vocabulary/warning-sources.tsv still attributes uncited-acronym warnings (ARCHIVE, MASTERPLAN) to docs/fitness-lanes/archive-orphan.md; the file is now a retirement stub and could either be excluded from the warning sweep or the rows regenerated.
findings.recommended_action: In a follow-up doc-sync PR, re-run the glossary warning generator so retired lane stubs are skipped or re-attributed.

findings.summary: docs/CHANGELOG.md retains the historical 2026-05-14 entry 'M01-P08-IP-008 archive-orphan lane shipped' without an inline back-link to the 2026-05-16 retirement entry. Trail is intact for top-down readers but a forward sentinel would help bottom-up readers.
findings.recommended_action: Optionally add a one-line '(retired 2026-05-16, see ADR-0118)' suffix to the older CHANGELOG row.

findings.summary: IP-008-archive-glue.md uses ad-hoc sentinel symbols 'RetiredArchiveDir / RetiredKernel / RetiredApp' in the Retired-symbols block, which look like real Rust identifiers but are documentation labels. A reader using grep for type names could be briefly confused.
findings.recommended_action: Rename the labels to clearly non-code forms (e.g. <retired:archive-dir>) in a follow-up doc pass.
